title: 六个固定版本公共数据池的质量、去重与溯源检查
hypothesis: 公开池并非互相独立；先核查标签与生成来源、跨池重复和官方数据重叠，形成可追溯的候选数据准入规则。
changes: 读取六个已登记公共数据集的固定版本与来源说明
检查字段/标签/空值、文本重复、prompt 家族与官方数据重叠
生成质量报告与逐行筛查标记；不训练模型

inputs.content_hashes_verified_scope: 27 fixed-version downloaded files and official train.csv; does not certify API identity or all upstream aggregate sources

config.exact_normalization: NFKC + casefold + collapse whitespace; audit only
config.near_duplicate_scope: external versus official train; approximate char similarity candidate screen
config.refusal_flags: screen only; no automatic assertion of mislabeled text
config.near_duplicate_candidate_rule: At least 3 distinct shared 8-word shingles with official train/public test, then char5 TF cosine >=0.90; not exhaustive cosine or semantics
config.normalization: NFKC + casefold + collapsed whitespace; audit hashes only; original text retained
config.pilot_candidate_selection: Five direct-source tables; exclude known official prompts, overlap candidates, provenance/label/format risk flags; deduplicate by normalized text

validation.scope: Public pool data audit; no classifier training, OOF or leaderboard score
validation.leakage_audit: Known prompt lineage exclusions saved; 252 prvs clean train_regen and at least 121 v5 rows require fold-aware isolation. Unknown semantic/prompt overlap remains.

timing_note: Local audit 26.64 s excluding download/dependency setup. No GPU/API generation/Colab usage. Source cost_usd fields belong to their authors, not this run.
conclusion: 6个固定版本、9张回答表共207125条记录，规范化后125411段不同文本；无冲突标签或官方原文精确重复。发现题目级验证风险与上游重叠；保存15989条初试候选索引和逐行排除折。8项检查通过；没有新模型分数。
limitations: 只核查六个固定版本；汇总池其他上游尚未逐个溯源；8词片段筛查不是全量语义去重；proxy slug不能独立证明模型版本；候选类别数量不均衡、收益未验证。
next_action: EXP-009 已查明大部分候选被基线使用。后续以现有stylegram/SVC数据配方为对照，比较权重和选择规则，不把4158条当作新增。
